maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly digital media and subscriptions/advertising (People Inc., Dotdash Meredith, Care.com, Angi); not repair-based installed-base servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from advertising, consumers and home-service businesses paying privately, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its operating brands like People Inc. and Angi; Meredith was a large deal, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers and readers can easily switch from its media publishing and marketplace brands; low switching costs.

notes: IAC is a holding company; answers reflect the largest part, People Inc. (publishing), with Angi and others.
